name: Let It Die - Complete Save Editor & Encyclopedia
changelog: Fixed Chinese language display: Blueprints, Materials, and Decals now display complete official Chinese names and descriptions extracted from master game data.
Bilingual display format in lists: shows Chinese names alongside original English names for clearer recognition.
Multilingual search filter support: search Blueprints, Materials, and Decals in English, Spanish, or Chinese seamlessly.
Integrated external JSON translation files under locales/ (en.json, es.json, zh.json) with fallback and dynamic reload.
All 86 automated unit tests passing across English, Spanish, and Chinese.
